study.question: On the under_normalized host with the norm seed, does a scheduled mid-training graft repair the deficit: does it beat no growth beyond delta, without static capacity from step zero beating it?
study.launch_condition: Launch ONLY if positive-control-v1 reads control_passes. Committed before positive-control-v1 is analysed, so nothing in this plan can depend on that study's results.
based_on: The exploratory sweep (seeds 5001-5002) computed graft numbers on this configuration (scheduled - no growth -0.060 and -0.105). They were seen. They are not used for sizing and their seeds are excluded.

units.definition: one training seed; matched three-arm unit
units.population_note: Fresh seeds disjoint from the positive control (2001-2048), whose scheduled arms are sealed, and from every exploratory unit.

endpoint.metric: development cross-entropy (nats) over all 5,000 dev examples
endpoint.per_unit_reduction: mean dev CE over the late epochs per arm; one paired difference per unit per contrast

analysis.test: paired t intervals at 97.5% (Bonferroni over two co-primaries), percentile bootstrap check
analysis.exclusions: None. Failed units are recorded and never re-run.
analysis.descriptive_note: static_minus_no_growth is reported on this study's own seeds (95% interval, no verdict, no multiplicity charge) so the capture fraction can be described. Per-epoch arm means for every epoch are reported, so a static advantage that is still closing at the horizon is visible.

readings.reopen_instrument_imprecise: The no-op contrast does not resolve (half-width > delta): report the MDE; redesign.
readings.partial_capture: Static beats the graft (scheduled - static CI lower > 0) AND the graft beats no growth (scheduled - no growth CI upper < 0): the lifecycle repairs part of the deficit. Report the capture fraction descriptively. Reopen birth timing and the blend schedule before any controller work, but record that the graft does repair.
readings.reopen_static_wins: Static beats the graft and the graft does not beat no growth: at this horizon the graft captures none of the repair. Part of a static advantage at a ten-epoch horizon may be a head start rather than repair quality; check the trajectories before calling it structural.
readings.reopen_static_not_credible: The no-op contrast resolves, the static contrast does not, and static does not win: report; the graft-vs-static question needs more units.
readings.progress: The graft beats no growth beyond delta and static does not beat it: the lifecycle captures (nearly) all of the repair. Shape rung 4 (do timing and location change the outcome).
readings.reopen_no_value: Precise, but the graft beats neither no growth beyond delta nor reaches partial capture: no repair captured at this scale.

decision.cost_note: The norm seed adds 129 parameters (~1.0008x), so parameter cost does not separate the arms; optimizer parameter-steps and wall time are reported from the run summaries.

sizing.method: 4,000 simulated 48-unit studies through the committed graft-capture-v1 rule; static benefit 0.15; correlation between the two co-primary differences 0.3
sizing.superseded: The earlier figure of 0.103 for an 80% progress chance covered the no-op contrast alone. Progress is a conjunction, so that figure is withdrawn (PDR-0046 F2).

predictions.expected_reading: partial_capture. The exploratory point estimate is a capture of about 0.46 (graft -0.083 vs static -0.18 over no growth); at a capture of 0.5 the rule reads partial_capture with probability >= 0.97.

disclosures: The reading rule graft-capture-v1 replaced bounded-screen-v1 after a pre-launch review (PDR-0046 F1). The v1 rule ranked 'static wins' above everything, so it could not tell partial capture from none. No confirmatory unit of either study had run.
